readings: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average signed CPU–GPU usage gap (the average of `proccpu` minus `procgpu` per record, so it can be negative, and records missing either value are skipped), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.

Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average absolute CPU–GPU usage gap (the average of the absolute value of `proccpu` minus `procgpu` per record, so it is never negative, and records missing either value are skipped), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remain,
         AVG(CASE WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL THEN sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu END) AS avg_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remain, avg_gap,
       avg_remain / (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) FROM g) AS ratio
FROM g
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remain,
         AVG(CASE WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL THEN ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) END) AS avg_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, avg_remain, avg_gap,
       avg_remain / (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) FROM g) AS ratio
FROM g
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
